== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sylvan Riverseed{{!}}Sylvan Riverseeds are natural spirits that emerge from locations where [[vital aura]] is both perfectly balanced and exceptionally potent. Unlike [[Remnants]], which result from the passing of a [[sacred artist]], [[Riverseeds]] are created by the accumulation of [[aura]]. They are characterized by their gentle nature and high degree of flexibility, allowing them to interact with and support almost any type of power. Because they are so malleable, skilled artisans can repurpose them into various forms, including weapons, guides, power sources, guardians, [[elixirs]], or even luxury beverages. In their unintelligent state, they can also serve as materials for [[Soulsmithing]] or assist in growing specific plants that require neutral [[aura]] environments. Individually, they possess significant spiritual weight and can exhibit personality through chimes, gestures, and emotional responses. They are capable of interacting with [[madra channels]] to soothe or stabilize them, and they can occupy substantial space within a person's [[soulspace]].}}
